story_log.title: Chiefs demolish Broncos 31-10 on Monday Night Football — Patrick Mahomes returns from ACL, Kenneth Walker III Chiefs debut, Bo Nix disaster
story_log.development: Chiefs beat Broncos 31-10 per ground truth. Mahomes' first game back from torn ACL (9 months to the day): 15-27, 207 total yards, 3 total TD (2 rush, 1 pass) — ran speed option on opening drive, scored 2 rush TD on first possession per BillBarnwell/Ihartitz/ESPN. Kenneth Walker III Chiefs debut: 26 touches, 191 total yards (173 rush — most for any KC player since Mahomes became starter per Schefter/StatMuse), 2 total TD including 60-yard TD run on 4th & 1 per StatMuse/ClutchPoints/SharpFootball. Bo Nix disaster: Broncos faced 3rd & 11, 3rd & 17, 2nd & 15, 3rd & 16, 3rd & 16 on different possessions per BillBarnwell — threw INT on first pass of season per ESPN. Jaylen Waddle Broncos debut: 1 REC, 2 YDS, 3 TAR per StatMuse. Broncos only team to score fewer than 10 points in Week 1 per StatMuse. Chiefs rushed for 200+ yards at Arrowhead for first time since 2016 per StatMuse. Walker broke more tackles on 60-yard run than Kareem Hunt might have broken all of 2025 per BillBarnwell.

story_log.development: Yankees clinched playoff berth (9th time in 10 years) per TalkinBaseball/ground truth. Yankees beat Twins 8-3 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Dodgers clinch playoff berth for 14th straight season behind Tarik Skubal's dominant outing
story_log.development: Dodgers clinched playoff berth (14th straight season) after beating Reds 4-1 per ground truth/TalkinBaseball/CBS Sports. Tarik Skubal dominant: 7.0 IP, 3 H, 0 R, 1 BB, 9 SO, 1.80 ERA this month per StatMuse. Dodgers now 14 straight years in postseason.

story_log.title: Mets eliminated from playoff contention after 2-1 loss to Orioles
story_log.development: Mets eliminated from playoff contention after losing 2-1 to Orioles per TalkinBaseball/ground truth. Pete Alonso nearly hit 300th career HR (foul by inches) per TalkinBaseball. Gunnar Henderson go-ahead shot in 8th gave Orioles lead per TalkinBaseball. New York's season ends.

story_log.title: Kawhi Leonard trade to Raptors finalized — Clippers gave final sign-off after 13 days absorbing NBA penalties
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 13]: Trade finalized Monday per Shams — Clippers and Raptors completed deal sending Kawhi to Toronto for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one pick swap, two second-rounders per Shams. Agreed June 30, paused amid NBA investigation, Clippers gave final sign-off after utilizing last 13 days to absorb league punishment and work through internal logistics per Shams. Kawhi waived $7.45M trade kicker to facilitate per Shams/BobbyMarks42. Raptors now pressed at first apron per BobbyMarks42. StatMuse: Kawhi and Kyle Anderson .783 win%, better than Jordan-Pippen .744, Shaq-Kobe .729, LeBron-Wade .702.

story_log.title: Drew Brees mulled coming out of retirement to play for Broncos in AFC Championship after Bo Nix injury
story_log.development: Brees seriously considered joining Denver for AFC Championship game after Bo Nix injury per Schefter/ESPN/PatMcAfeeShow. Brees worked out but wrist was bothering him per PatMcAfeeShow. Would have been 47 years old. Broncos tried to lure him out of retirement for Super Bowl bid.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits 42nd HR of season, extends 40-30 club dominance
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 9]: PCA hit 42nd HR vs Atlanta per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints (4-5, 1 HR, 1 2B, 4 RBI per StatMuse). Now 42 HR, 37 SB this season. Cubs beat Braves 7-3 per ground truth. MVP race continues.

story_log.title: Tigers rally twice Monday — Louis Varland drops ball at first allowing go-ahead run, Tigers break up Jose Soriano no-hitter in 7th and score 3 to take lead
story_log.development: Detroit beat Toronto 6-5 per ground truth — Varland dropped ball at first base allowing go-ahead run per TalkinBaseball. Tigers also beat Angels 6-5 per ground truth — Soriano had no-hitter going into 7th, Tigers broke it up and scored 3 runs to take lead per TalkinBaseball. Wild Monday for Detroit.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll walk-off 2-run HR gives Diamondbacks dramatic win over Marlins
story_log.development: Carroll hit walk-off 2-run HR for Arizona per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Diamondbacks beat Marlins 8-7 per ground truth. Lars Nootbaar tied game earlier per ClutchPoints. Wild finish.

story_log.title: White Sox allow 3+ unearned runs and 0 earned runs in back-to-back games — first team since 1942 Yankees
story_log.development: White Sox allowed 3+ unearned runs and 0 earned runs in consecutive games per JayCuda — last team to do this was 1942 Yankees per JayCuda. White Sox beat Guardians 7-3 per ground truth. Defensive disaster, pitching okay.

story_log.title: Tristan Peters draws 18-pitch walk — most pitches White Sox batter has seen in at-bat since MLB started tracking in 1988
story_log.development: Peters saw 18 pitches in walk per JomboyMedia — most by White Sox batter since MLB started tracking pitch counts in 1988 per JomboyMedia. Just 10th time in that span an at-bat featured 18+ pitches, first since Matt Wieters 19-pitch flyout in 2020 per JomboyMedia. Chicago won 7-3 vs Cleveland per ground truth.

story_log.title: Arch Manning admits he got 'good laugh' from AI video of Steve Sarkisian slapping Holly Rowe — probably should've kept that to himself
story_log.development: Manning shared story about AI-edited video of Sark slapping Holly Rowe to ground per RedditCFB/HaterReport/NFLMemes — said he 'got a good laugh' and 'that's a good one' per HaterReport. Media training needed ASAP per HaterReport. Immediately regrettable quote.

story_log.title: Taj Gibson retires after 17 NBA seasons, returns to Chicago Bulls as assistant coach under Tiago Splitter
story_log.development: Gibson retired after 17 NBA seasons, returning to Bulls as assistant coach under Splitter per Shams. Career comes full circle.

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 1]: This is the Chiefs-Broncos MNF game from yesterday's raw content, now with final result. Lead with what changed: the final score, the dominant performances, the disaster class. Reader knows Mahomes was returning from ACL, knows Kenneth Walker was acquired — cover how they actually performed and what the game looked like. Key stats: Mahomes 15-27, 207 total yards, 3 total TD (2 rush on opening drive per BillBarnwell/Ihartitz), ran speed option despite everyone saying he wouldn't run early in year per BillBarnwell. Kenneth Walker: 26 touches, 191 total yards (173 rush — most for any KC player since Mahomes became starter per Schefter), 2 total TD including 60-yard TD run on 4th & 1 per StatMuse/ClutchPoints. Chiefs rushed for 200+ yards at Arrowhead for first time since 2016 per StatMuse. Walker broke more tackles on one run than Kareem Hunt might have broken all of 2025 per BillBarnwell. Bo Nix disaster: threw INT on first pass of season per ESPN, Broncos faced 3rd & 11, 3rd & 17, 2nd & 15, 3rd & 16, 3rd & 16 on different possessions per BillBarnwell, only team to score fewer than 10 points in Week 1 per StatMuse. Jaylen Waddle Broncos debut: 1 REC, 2 YDS, 3 TAR per StatMuse. SharpFootball: 'whoa — QBs the Broncos defeated in 2025: Trey Lance, Chris Oladokun, Jordan Love, Kenny Pickett/Geno, Marcus Mariota, Patrick Mahomes (Wk 11), Geno, Davis Mills/CJ, Dak, Jaxson Dart, Justin Fields, Jalen Hurts, Jake Browning, Cam Ward.' Broncos tackling was atrocious per multiple SharpFootball clips. Chiefs had Justin Fields in formation for Walker's 60-yard TD per SportsCenter. Andy Reid dialed up play from 1900s film per HaterReport/goldmctNFL. Taylor Swift and Tom Cruise in attendance per ESPN. Kenneth Walker said film they watched to learn the play was tough to see because it was from the 1900s per HaterReport. Drunk Seahawks GM John Schneider at Super Bowl parade: 'Kenneth Walker tried negotiating with me five minutes ago. It was really weird' per HaterReport. This was a statement game: Mahomes is back, the Chiefs have a real running back for the first time in years, and the Broncos are still the Broncos.
